request.query: membership in Finset.Iic a iff x ≤ a for locally finite partial order and Finsupp pointwise order

items.name: Finset.mem_Iic
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Preorder α] [inst_1 : LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] {a x : α}, x ∈ Finset.Iic a ↔ x ≤ a

items.name: LocallyFiniteOrderBot.finset_mem_Iic
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {inst : Preorder α} [self : LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] (a x : α),
  x ∈ LocallyFiniteOrderBot.finsetIic a ↔ x ≤ a

items.name: Finset.Iic
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → [inst : Preorder α] → [LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] → α → Finset α

items.name: LocallyFiniteOrderBot.finsetIic
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {inst : Preorder α} → [self : LocallyFiniteOrderBot α] → α → Finset α

items.name: LocallyFiniteOrderBot.ofIic
items.type:
(α : Type u_1) →
  [inst : PartialOrder α] →
    [DecidableEq α] → (finsetIic : α → Finset α) → (∀ (a x : α), x ∈ finsetIic a ↔ x ≤ a) → LocallyFiniteOrderBot α
